Water is being poured into a rectangular prism shaped tank. The length and width of this tank are 8 m and 4 m, respectively. If the height of the water increases at a rate of 0.25 m/hour, determine the rate at which the volume of stored water increases.

a
6m3/hour
b
8m3/hour
c
18m3/hour
d
14m3/hour
e
10m3/hour
